name: Bitbucket Runner
description: Bitbucket Runner is a minimal base virtual machine (Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04) prepared for running a Bitbucket self-hosted runner. The runner software is not pre-installed; you install and configure it after first boot using your repository's runner setup token.

notes.text: The Bitbucket self-hosted runner is NOT pre-installed. This is a minimal base VM; install and configure the runner after first boot using your repository's runner setup token.
At least 8GB of RAM is recommended. The script warns if you select less than 8192 MiB.
Enable Cloud-Init during setup to configure SSH keys and network automatically.
